segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Good morning. How can I help you?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Hello. I'm interested in renting a house somewherein the town.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Right. Could I have your name please?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Yes, it's Steven Godfrey.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: And tell me how many bedroomsyou're looking for.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Well, we'd need four, because I'm going to share the house with three friends.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Okay, there are several of that size on our books. They mostly belong to families who are working abroad at the moment.What about the location?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: It'd be nice to be central.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: That might be difficult, as most houses of that size are in the suburbs. Still, there are a few. What's your upper limit for the rent?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: We'd like somethingaround £500 a month, but we could go up to £600 if we have to. But we can't go beyond that.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Do you know how long you want to rent the house for? The minimumlet is six months,as you probably realise.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: We're at college here for two years, and we don't want to have to move during that time if we can avoid it.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Right. And how soon do you want to move in? All our lets start on the first of the month.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Well, as soon as possible, really, so that means September 1st•

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Okay, let me have a look at what we've got .... We have photographsof all the houses on our books, so you can get an idea of what they're like. There's this one in OakingtonAvenue, at £550 a month. Combinedliving room and dining room, with a separate kitchen. It doesn't have a garage, though you can park in the road.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Ah, we'd prefer to have one, if possible.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Right. Then have a look at this house, in Mead Street. It's got a very large living room and kitchen, bathroom,cloakroom ...

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: How much is it?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: That one's 580. Ifs very well furnished and equipped. It also has plenty of space for parking, and it's availablefor a minimum of a year. Oh, and there's a big garden.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: I don't think we could cope with that, to be honest. We'll be too busy to look after it.

segments.speaker: WOMAN'.
segments.en: Okay. Then there's this older house in Hamilton Road: living room, kitchen-diner,and it has a study. 550 a month.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: That looks rather nice. But whereaboutsin Hamilton Road?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Towards the western end.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Oh, that'll be very noisy. I know the area.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Yes, it's pretty lively. Some people like it, though. Well, what about this house in Devon Close?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: That looks lovely.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: There's a big demand for houses in that area, so prices tend to be quite high. But this one hasn't been decoratedfor a few years, which has kept the rent down a bit. It's got a living room, dining room and small kitchen, and it's 595 a month. I think it would suit you, from what you've said. QB

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: It sounds fine.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Why's that part of town so popular?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Well, there's a big scheme to improvethe district, and it'll soon have the best facilities for miles around. ·

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: What sort of thing?

segments.speaker: WOMAN'.
segments.en: There's a big sports centre under construction,which will be very impressivewhen it's finished. In fact the swimming pool's already opened, & 10 ahead of schedule, and it's attracting a lot of people.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: What about cinemas: are there any in the area?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: The only one closed down last year, and it's now in the process of being convertedinto a film museum.The local people are trying to get a new cinema added to the scheme.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: I think I heard somethingabout a plan to replace the existing concert hall & 10 with a larger one.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Ah, that's due to start next year.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Well it sounds an interestingarea to live in. Could I go and see the house, please?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Yes, of course.
